blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Rains are expected over parts of Southern Luzon, Visayas and Mindanao on Thursday, Sept. 17, as the intertropical convergence zone (ITCZ), a convergence of winds, affects these areas, the state weather bureau said. The Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) said in its weather advisory that the ITCZ will bring gloomy skies and rains over the following areas: READ: Visayas, Mindanao to experience heavy rains Wednesday Meanwhile, the rest of Mindanao may experience partly cloudy to cloudy skies with isolated rain showers or thunderstorms, also due to the ITCZ.
